Zara (Growth): Quick ask 1: webinar + benchmark launch next week. Need a tight SEO checklist today: keywords, minimal JSON-LD (Event + FAQ), internal linking anchors for launch posts, and a redirect map for the gated benchmark PDF. Can we lock by EOD?
Noah (SEO): Ill take keywords + schema. Two primaries: "inference benchmark" and "LLM inference cost benchmarks" plus 4 longtails. Will drop a short sheet.
Ivy (Content): Internal linking plan: add 1x contextual link per launch post to /benchmark-summary with anchor "benchmark results", add CTA on docs page to webinar register, update related-posts widget.
Evan (DevOps): Redirects: prefer /downloads/benchmark-v2.pdf for gated file. I'll add 301s. Example nginx rule:
rewrite ^/benchmark$ /benchmark-summary permanent;
rewrite ^/benchmark/pdf$ /downloads/benchmark-v2.pdf permanent;
curl -I check pattern included in PR.
Noah (SEO): FAQ schema snippet (paste to head): {"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"FAQPage","mainEntity":[{"@type":"Question","name":"What does the benchmark cover?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Latency, throughput, and cost across model configs."}}]}
Zara (Growth): Notes: summary page = indexable canonical, gated PDF = noindex, follow, set X-Robots-Tag on download response. Also ensure OG meta points to summary.
OpsBot: link-scan scheduled 07:00 UTC tomorrow; will DM any broken links.
Ivy (Content): Deliverables: keyword list + canonical column by 5pm; Evan -> redirects CSV + smoke test commands; Noah -> JSON-LD + OG title recommendation.
Zara (Growth): Thanks team 60; will sign off when artifacts are in drive.
